description: This file defines a Java class 'Variance' which computes the variance of a dataset. It includes methods for incremental updates, evaluating variance over arrays or subarrays, handling weights, and configurable bias correction. The class uses internal classes like 'SecondMoment' and extends 'AbstractStorelessUnivariateStatistic'. It is part of the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: Variance
classes.description: A class for calculating variance with options for bias correction and support for weighted data. It supports incremental computation as well as evaluation over arrays or subarrays.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Adds a new value to the dataset, updating internal statistics if incMoment is true.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the current variance based on accumulated data, considering bias correction.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Computes the variance of input array(s), possibly over a subarray or with weights.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the internal state, clearing accumulated data.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Variance instance.
